project_context.vibe: Premium yet approachable, modern minimal, elegance, craftsmanship

themes.strategy: Dual Context. Customer Frontend is Light/Earthy Minimalist (shows off product imagery). Admin Dashboard is High-Density Soft Light theme (for functional clarity without strain). Avoid pure dark mode for the customer side to maintain the editorial white-space jewelry aesthetic.

typography.headlines_customer: Cormorant Garamond (font-light to font-medium) for an elegant, editorial feel.
typography.headlines_admin: Outfit (font-semibold) for clean, high-density data views.
typography.body: Manrope (font-normal to font-medium) for high legibility across platforms.
typography.monospace: JetBrains Mono (for item numbers like NJE-Silver-001).
rules: Customer H1 maximum: text-5xl to text-6xl with tracking-tighter.

visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays on hero sections to kill digital flatness.
visual enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, no hard dark dropshadows.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-white/40) for sticky navs.

component name: Shadcn Slider (customize defaultValue={[min, max]} for dual-handle price range)
Shadcn Checkbox (for category multi-select in sidebar)
Shadcn Select (for sort dropdown and form inputs)
Shadcn Dialog (for product detail modal if used)

grids.customer_gallery: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8. High visual impact, breathable spacing.
grids.admin_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Dense metric summary cards at top, wide table below.

layouts.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing: p-8, p-12, p-16 for sections in Customer view.
layouts.product_card: Cardless layout. Image container aspect-[4/5] bg-[#F2F0EB], text outside container. No borders.
layouts.admin_layout: Fixed sidebar on left, scrollable main content area. Strict hierarchy.

motion.hover_states: Images slightly scale up inside overflow-hidden. Buttons shift -translate-y-[2px] with shadow-md.
motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion for staggered fade-ins of the product gallery.

accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8C5A4F].
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='price-filter-slider', data-testid='product-card-1').

media.images: High-quality, unfiltered aesthetic. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Max overlay bg-black/30.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific clean e-commerce grid, but if a hero section is added later, use React Spring Parallax for 2.5D layer depth.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js and .jsx files. DO NOT use .tsx or TypeScript under any circumstances.
Use react-router-dom for routing between '/' (Customer) and '/admin' (Dashboard).
Format prices using new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).format(price).
For the Customer frontend, build a responsive layout with a persistent sidebar filter (on desktop) and a sheet/drawer on mobile.
Implement the Dual-Handle slider for price range using Shadcn UI's Slider component (ensure it handles array defaultValue properly for min/max).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='category-filter-earrings').
Admin Dashboard: Build JWT login flow. Main dashboard requires a dense data table for products and metric summary cards. Ensure a drag-and-drop zone in the product create form.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions to avoid breaking transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop-blur and semi-transparent borders.
Avoid default SaaS blue colors. Stick to the Earthy Elegance palette provided.
Do not use generic AI emojis for icons. Use real SVG icons (lucide-react).
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Ensure readability.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults (e.g., p-8 instead of p-4).
Form validation messages should be clear, concise, and accessible.
